notes.title: New update is almost ready!
notes.notes:
This gonna be a really big update with A LOT of new content!

What can you expect ?

- Shop where you can buy five tiers of each wepon
- BOSS every 10 levels (first boss will be easy, next medium and so on)
- New weapon! BOMB! 
- No longer free health, potions etc. Now you need to buy this for collected gold
- New biomes
- Each biom will have different music
- FREE DLC WITH OST
- New leaderboard "Boss killed in one run"

notes.title: Update #4
notes.notes:
In this update:

- Added Pause Manu
- Added Save / Continue system, 
(it saves you level numer, gold collected and health only, but you will start from the entrance door. Save button is available when you open Pause Menu)
- Added gamepad configuration,
- Now game save your key config so when you close the game your key config will be there,
- Now chest can drop some gold but also... you have 30% chance to find a bomb :)
- Whip has now extended range (thx for the advice FN-9725),
- More sounds fx

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
I have for you a new update with some great features:

- Local CO-OP (Player 2 can play only by gamepad)
- Friendly fire in CO-OP (so be careful where you shoot :) )
- Respawn system in CO-OP (When you die you will respawn when second player finish the level)
- 2 new biomes randomly generated
- 3 new enemies (Basher, Bouncer, Bomber)
- Controller support (you don't have to configure anything, simply turn on your controller and play)
- Configure Controls
- F11 Toggle Full Screen

Also some small bug was fixed.
